notes.title: Slobbish Dragon Princess 3 Released on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41852479/049ff7c4405afa2d23e28c05991ea2a4d12fd447.png[/img]

That's right! Slobbish Dragon Princess 3 has just released on Steam! If you love cute NEET dragon girls, don't pass this up! Don't forget to check out other titles from the developer Whirlpool on Steam while you're here.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1469910/Slobbish_Dragon_Princess/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1752150/Slobbish_Dragon_Princess_2

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2225250/Slobbish_Dragon_Princess_3/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1972190/Animal_Trail__Girlish_Square/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/407310/NEKONIN_exHeart/

Follow [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/41852479-Whirlpool-Dev/]Whirlpool on Steam[/url]

And don't forget to follow [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/sekaiproject]Sekai Project on Steam[/url] as well for more content!
